exercises.passage: Pizza is one of the most popular foods in the world, but it was not always like this. About two hundred years ago, in the city of Naples in Italy, pizza was cheap food for poor workers. They bought it in the street and ate it quickly. In 1889, the Queen of Italy visited Naples. A cook named Raffaele Esposito made her a special pizza with tomatoes, white cheese and green basil, the colors of the Italian flag. The queen loved it, and the pizza got her name: Margherita. Later, many Italians moved to the United States and opened pizza shops there. After World War Two, American soldiers who had eaten pizza in Italy wanted it at home too. Today people eat pizza with almost everything on top, even pineapple, although many Italians think that is a terrible idea!
exercises.question: Who ate pizza in Naples two hundred years ago?
exercises.explain_he: כתוב: pizza was cheap food for poor workers.
